name: Eating Catfish
overview: Scripture teaches that God has provided specific guidelines regarding what may be eaten, emphasizing His sovereign authority over creation and health. In Leviticus, God commands that only creatures with fins and scales from the waters are permissible for consumption, which would exclude catfish as they lack scales. This dietary law reflects God's care for His people, promising health and protection when His statutes are obeyed, as seen in Exodus. From the beginning, God intended plants and fruits for food, and His instructions in the Law further define clean and unclean foods, guiding believers to honor Him through obedience in all aspects of life.
